Native windowed-recurrence functional sensitivity and source-pinned recovery metadata

etr_native_functional_rqa_recovery.Rd

Six mapped public Python-source integrations plus the optional native value-key helper: fixed-radius multiscale windowed RQA sensitivity, unit-level simultaneous derived RQA mean bands, and metadata and recovery-value catalog utilities pinned to the published Python 1.2.0 source.

Usage

etr_windowed_rqa_sensitivity(trajectories, metrics, window_step_pairs,
  window_units = "samples", step_units = "samples", radius = NULL,
  target_recurrence_rate = NULL, metric = "euclidean",
  theiler_window = 0L, theiler_window_units = "samples",
  dimensions = NULL, min_diagonal_length = 2L,
  min_vertical_length = 2L, undefined_policy = "raise")
etr_windowed_rqa_functional_mean_band(trajectories, metrics,
  window, step, unit, participant_column = NULL,
  window_units = "samples", step_units = "samples",
  radius = NULL, target_recurrence_rate = NULL,
  metric = "euclidean",
  theiler_window = 0L, theiler_window_units = "samples",
  dimensions = NULL, min_diagonal_length = 2L,
  min_vertical_length = 2L, confidence_level = 0.95,
  n_multiplier = 2000L, random_state = 0L,
  gaussian_multiplier_draws = NULL, random_engine = "numpy")
etr_functional_recovery_metric_catalog()
etr_functional_recovery_metric_catalog_frame()
etr_functional_recovery_value_key(value)
etr_functional_recovery_assessment_frame(assessment, python_boundary_mode = FALSE)
etr_functional_recovery_reporting_text(assessment, python_boundary_mode = FALSE)

Arguments

trajectories

Complete native functional trajectories, with analyst-declared scientific coordinate system and time units.

metrics

Unique windowed RQA statistic names.

window_step_pairs

Nonempty list or two-column numeric matrix of explicit (window, step) pairs. Each list entry can be an atomic numeric vector or a two-element list of numeric scalars (for example list(5L, 2.0)), as accepted by the pinned Python source. Boolean, text, nonfinite and malformed scalar entries remain invalid. Sample-unit counts must be integral; physical-time widths may be fractional if exactly grid-convertible.

window,step

Positive explicit window and step widths in the declared sample or physical-time units.

window_units,step_units,theiler_window_units

Either sample units or compatible physical time (including s/ms aliases), converted to whole observed samples on an approximately regular time grid.

radius

Optional finite positive fixed recurrence radius; supply exactly one radius policy.

target_recurrence_rate

Optional target density strictly between zero and one, using a source-aligned inclusive-radius search. The achieved rate may differ owing to ties.

metric

Recurrence distance metric: "euclidean", "cityblock" or "chebyshev".

theiler_window

Nonnegative Theiler exclusion in the units declared by theiler_window_units.

dimensions

Optional named source dimensions to analyze.

min_diagonal_length,min_vertical_length

RQA diagonal and vertical run-length thresholds.

undefined_policy

"raise" or "keep" for selected windowed RQA metrics. The mean-band wrapper requires complete values.

unit

Either independent source "curve" or declared "participant" inference units.

participant_column

Source metadata column grouping repeated trials by participant when unit="participant".

confidence_level,n_multiplier,random_state

Gaussian multiplier simultaneous mean-band calibration settings. A nonnegative integer seed below \(2^{53}\) selects a reproducible stream. NULL uses the current R RNG stream.

random_engine

Use "numpy" for source-seeded Gaussian draws or "base_R" to reproduce previous native seeded mean bands.

gaussian_multiplier_draws

Optional finite source-aligned numeric matrix with one row per Gaussian multiplier replicate and one column per independent curve or participant. This explicit native extension enables same-draw numerical replay with frozen Python 1.2 and takes precedence over the seed.

value

Native semantic recovery value with metric, source and zero-based component fields.

assessment

Native assessment list with a nonempty values list of finite recovery values. Built-in and custom metric definitions carry direction, units, scope and description.

python_boundary_mode

Use source text stripping, numeric scalar coercion, and same-name custom metric metadata for mapped records. Reporting accepts an explicit NULL estimator or a plain R scalar, list or named mapping with source-compatible representation.

Value

etr_windowed_rqa_sensitivity returns native analyses, design and overlap-reuse table, a descriptive per-curve/metric summary and pairwise exact shared-center discrepancy table, without interpolation. etr_windowed_rqa_functional_mean_band returns a native whole-unit simultaneous mean band for derived RQA functions. The recovery catalog returns 27 ordered named S3 definitions or an auditable six-column native data frame; value-key returns one string, assessment-frame returns a native semantic value data frame, and reporting-text returns a compact source-aligned manuscript description.

Details

The native implementation supports explicit sample or convertible physical-time windows, optional source-aligned target-density threshold selection, and three distance metrics. When density controls the threshold, recurrence_rate is not allowed as a derived outcome. Python dataclasses, pandas schemas and some exceptional input domains remain scientifically distinct from the native representations. These capabilities do not establish full Python source parity. Inference resamples entire derived functions at the declared independent curve/participant unit, never overlapping time windows independently. The temporal distance between RQA window centers is not an estimate of independent information resolution. Full source certification requires domain-wide oracle qualification and independent review.
